src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_cd119_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 119th Congress's districts (its file says session 119).
rec: State of Georgia notice to the court (Grant v. Raffensperger): SB 1EX, HB 1EX and SB 3EX signed Dec. 8, 2023 (copy hosted by Loyola Law School)

Drawn after the N.D. Ga. court (Judge Jones, Oct. 26, 2023) found the 2021 maps diluted Black votes under VRA section 2; signed Dec. 8, 2023 and approved by the court Dec. 28, 2023. Census file basis: the cached 2024 legislative file says LSY 2024 (checked: GA 14 districts); the 119th Congress file is the plan the Congress elected in November 2024 sits under.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: State of Georgia notice to the court (Grant v. Raffensperger): SB 1EX, HB 1EX and SB 3EX signed Dec. 8, 2023 (copy hosted by Loyola Law School)

Replaces the 2021 Senate plan of the same bill number (S.B. 1EX of the 2021 special session). Court approval Dec. 28, 2023. Census file basis: the cached 2024 legislative file says LSY 2024 (checked: GA sldu 56 districts, LSY 2024); the 119th Congress file is the plan the Congress elected in November 2024 sits under.
